appimagetool: appimagetool (AppImage/appimagetool), the AppImage packer the obs-studio build runs.
brotli: Brotli 1.2.1 (google/brotli): the shared codec libraries libcurl decodes with; the AlmaLinux 8 base's 1.0.6 is inside CVE-2026-111497's range.
curl: curl 8.23.0 (curl/curl): the pinned libcurl the AppImage loads (base has 7.61.1, EOL), built --with-ca-fallback against the pinned brotli 1.2.1.
ffmpeg: FFmpeg with the codecs OBS ships (x264, aom, svt-av1, vpx, opus, vorbis, theora, lame, srt, librist, mbedtls, nv-codec headers): shared libraries and headers.
implib: Implib.so (yugr/Implib.so): generates the lazy-loading shims for optional host libraries (#959).
openssl: OpenSSL 3.5.9 (LTS): the TLS runtime of the pinned libcurl; curl 8.18+ requires OpenSSL >= 3.0, so the base's EOL 1.1.1k cannot back it.
pipewire: PipeWire client library, modules, SPA plugins and client.conf.
qt6: Qt 6 (qtbase, qtsvg, qtwayland on Linux): shared libraries, headers, CMake packages and plugins for building OBS-Studio-Rust.
uv: uv (astral-sh/uv), the Python runner the obs-studio build scripts use.
